tests.name: unflatten_deep_array_pointer
tests.intent: Probes unflattening with a deep pointer containing multiple array indices ('/0/0/.../0') to test the prefix tree construction and linear traversal.

tests.name: unflatten_deep_object_pointer
tests.intent: Probes unflattening with a deep pointer containing only object keys to ensure prefix tree handles object-only paths correctly.

tests.name: unflatten_ordered_json_reverse_zero
tests.intent: Probes unflattening using ordered_json where a non-zero index or object key precedes the '0' reference token, verifying order independence.

tests.name: unflatten_mixed_array_and_object_paths
tests.intent: Probes unflattening with mixed array indices and object keys to verify correct branching in the prefix tree.

tests.name: json_pointer_to_string_stream
tests.intent: Probes streaming a json_pointer to an output stream to ensure public formatting is unaffected.

tests.name: json_pointer_comparison_operators
tests.intent: Probes comparison operators on json_pointer objects to ensure internal data structures did not affect pointer equality and ordering.

tests.name: unflatten_empty_json
tests.intent: Probes unflattening an empty JSON object to verify edge case handling with empty prefix trees.

tests.name: unflatten_invalid_array_index_leading_zero
tests.intent: Probes unflattening where an array index has a leading zero ('/01'), expecting a parse error or type error.

tests.name: unflatten_non_numeric_array_index
tests.intent: Probes unflattening where an array token is non-numeric, expecting an exception during unflattening.

tests.name: unflatten_root_pointer_collision
tests.intent: Probes unflattening with an empty pointer key ('') alongside other keys.

tests.name: json_pointer_concatenation_operators
tests.intent: Probes json_pointer construction and division operator ('/') to ensure pointer arithmetic works normally before unflattening.

tests.name: unflatten_flat_roundtrip
tests.intent: Probes flattening and then unflattening a complex nested JSON structure to verify identity round-trip.

tests.name: unflatten_multiple_sibling_arrays
tests.intent: Probes unflattening multiple branches that lead to arrays at different levels.

tests.name: unflatten_conflicting_types_throws
tests.intent: Probes unflattening when a path expects both an object and an array, triggering type error 313.

tests.name: unflatten_escaped_pointer_tokens
tests.intent: Probes unflattening with escaped JSON pointer tokens ('~0' and '~1') to ensure pointer token decoding integrates properly with the prefix tree.

tests.name: unflatten_single_element_object
tests.intent: Probes unflattening a flat object with a single top-level property.

tests.name: unflatten_sparse_array_indices
tests.intent: Probes unflattening with non-contiguous sparse array indices ('/0' and '/5') to check array creation behavior.

tests.name: unflatten_boolean_and_null_values
tests.intent: Probes unflattening flat objects containing boolean and null leaf values.

tests.name: unflatten_deep_mixed_tree
tests.intent: Probes unflattening a moderately deep alternating array and object hierarchy.

tests.name: json_pointer_empty_string
tests.intent: Probes creating and using an empty json_pointer string.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises prefix_tree struct instantiation and children map tracking via unflattening a nested object structure.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises is_array vector initialization and setting boolean flags for array parents when unflattening an array index.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises prefix_tree default constructor with empty vector of children and is_array flags.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercises child map lookups and reallocations in prefix_tree children vector with multiple overlapping keys.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises prefix_tree node extension and child index tracking via ordered_json unflattening with out-of-order keys.
